title: Extra storage in a small bathroom
text: Extra storage in a small bathroom. Our new apartment doesn't have a medicine cabinet.  We had large ones in our home.  The downsizing forced me to figure out what to do with all the stuff from the medicine cabinet.  These shelves solved that problem and gave my husband extra hooks for his robes, towels and PJs.  I don't like that the units "sway" when the door opens and closes and wish they would provide several little double faced, sticky, padded squares, to put under the joint so they don't rub on the door.  It also helped not to have to put a more expensive shelving unit above the toilet where I can now hang a nice piece of art.
